meta_title: SEDI Kitchens & Bedrooms | Kitchen Renovator Southampton
meta_description: SEDI Kitchens & Bedrooms transforms kitchens and bedrooms across Southampton. Custom designs, expert installation, free quotes. Call today.
hero_subhead: Tired of a cramped, dated kitchen? SEDI transforms Southampton homes with custom designs, quality fittings, and expert installation.
services_heading: Complete Kitchen & Bedroom Services in Southampton
services_subhead: From design to final install, we handle every stage of your renovation with precision and care.

services.title: Bespoke Kitchen Design
services.desc: Personalised 3D designs tailored to your space, lifestyle, and budget. We listen to your needs and create layouts that maximise storage and flow.

services.title: Kitchen Installation
services.desc: Expert fitting of units, worktops, appliances, and splash-backs. Our installers work methodically to minimise disruption and deliver a flawless finish.

services.title: Bedroom Furniture & Storage
services.desc: Custom wardrobes, fitted furniture, and bedroom suites designed to fit your room perfectly. Maximise your space with tailored storage solutions.

services.title: Worktop & Splashback Installation
services.desc: Precision fitting of granite, quartz, laminate, or wood worktops, plus matching splash-backs. Durable, beautiful, and built to last.

services.title: Kitchen Remodelling
services.desc: Full renovation service including structural changes, rewiring, replumbing, and new layouts. We manage the entire project so you don't have to.

services.title: Appliance Integration
services.desc: Seamless installation of built-in ovens, hobs, dishwashers, and tall appliances. Your kitchen functions beautifully and looks cohesive.

about_pullquote: We design kitchens people actually want to spend time in.
about_para_1: SEDI Kitchens & Bedrooms has been transforming Southampton homes for over a decade. We started because we saw too many generic, poorly fitted kitchens. Today, we specialise in bespoke design and meticulous installation—treating every project as if it were our own home.
about_para_2: Our customers return because we listen, deliver on time, and stand behind our work. We hold ourselves to a higher standard: clear pricing, no hidden costs, and installers who take pride in the details. Your satisfaction isn't a promise—it's our track record.
reviews_heading: What Southampton Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: We were daunted by the whole kitchen renovation, but SEDI made it painless. The design process was brilliant—they really understood what we wanted. Installation took 8 days and the lads were tidy, professional, and friendly. Absolutely thrilled with the result. Worth every penny.
reviews.author: Margaret D.

reviews.text: Had a bedroom fitted with new wardrobes. The design team created something we never thought possible in our space. Installation was smooth and quick. The craftsmanship is top-notch. Highly recommend if you're considering any kind of fitted furniture.
reviews.author: David P.

reviews.text: From the free consultation to the final tile, SEDI exceeded expectations. No surprises, no hidden costs, just a beautiful new kitchen that's actually functional. The team were respectful of our home and cleaned up thoroughly each day. Already recommending them to friends.
reviews.author: Rachel T.
